hero.title: File:WatchungSubRanges.png
hero.credit:
Created by roughly tracing a topographic map of the Watchungs with a resolution of 128 meters per pixel.

Base map: USGS Topo Quads  This image  by Lithium6ion (talk)
hero.description: The map above uses color shading to depict the various sub ranges and ridges of the Watchung Mountains.
hero.dateCreated:
April 2009 with subsquent modifcations.

13 April 2009 (original upload date); 4 January 2010 (last version))
categories: Maps of mountains in the United States
